title: checklist / add-tasks / poll-option dialogs close as soon as the request is sent; a server refusal loses the typed content
trigger: Compose a checklist (or Add Tasks, or a poll Add Option), press Create; the driver call returns Ok(request) so the dialog is set to None at once; TDLib then rejects the send (e.g. restricted chat, slow mode, deleted message)
effect: The dialog and everything typed in it are gone; only a generic status note remains, there is no way to retry without retyping
fix: Keep the dialog in a Sending { request: RequestId } stage and close it only on the matching answer; return it to Editing on error

title: EditMode::replace_as_file (bool) must change in step with the staged replacement it belongs to (ComposerEdit::media_edit.replacement)
trigger: Pick a replacement file while editing a media message, tick 'Send as document'; the replacement is cleared by clear_edit_replacement or a failed probe, and each of those sites resets replace_as_file by hand beside clearing the replacement
effect: No bug today; a new site that drops the replacement but forgets set_edit_replace_as_file(false) leaves the box ticked for the next file
fix: Make the as-file choice a field of the staged replacement value (Replacement { file, as_file }) so dropping the replacement drops the choice

title: CreateVisibility's busy state is read by purpose and chat (has_purpose_for_chat) rather than by the RequestId the box sent; check-request-match.py misses the _for_chat variant
trigger: Press Create on the create-community visibility box while another request of purpose CreateCommunity for the same chat is out (a second window, or the same send from an earlier box)
effect: The Create button shows loading / is disabled for a request this box did not send, and an answer for an earlier request ends the wrong wait
fix: Hold the create's RequestId in the box (CreateVisibility { sent: Option<RequestId> }, or a Creating { request } stage) and read busy from it; extend PURPOSE in scripts/check-request-match.py to has_purpose_for_chat

title: take_draft_clear falls back to any pending clear of the same chat (HashMap order) when the acked topic has none, instead of matching the request
trigger: Two topics of one forum chat each have a send waiting for its ack to clear the draft, or one has one and an unrelated send (a menu command that sets no clear) of another topic is acked first
effect: The ack takes some other topic's pending DraftClear, so that topic's draft can be cleared on the wrong ack, or the right ack finds nothing; which one is arbitrary (HashMap iteration order)
fix: Key the pending clear by the send's RequestId (DraftClear { request, .. }) and take it by the answered request, with no chat-id fallback

title: A waiting community ban (CommunitiesUi::ban_waits) can only leave on its member-chats answer; while another box stays open it waits with no cancel or expiry
trigger: Press Ban on a member who owns chats in the community, then open another box (Settings, a profile) and leave it open; the answer arrives and BanStep::Warn keeps returning false while any other dialog is up
effect: Closing that other box later pops the ban warning for a press the user has forgotten, and a ban queued behind it waits too; it needs a confirm, so nothing is banned unseen
fix: Make the wait one stage value with an owner and a cancel (BanWait::Asking { request } -> Warning), dropped when the box it was pressed from goes away
